statements.t: “Amneal delivered another quarter of strong, broad-based performance, enabling us to increase our 2026 guidance once more.

With the breadth and depth of opportunities across our portfolio, we remain highly confident in Amneal’s robust growth outlook,” said Chirag and Chintu Patel, Co-Founders and Co-Chief Executive Officers of Amneal.
We are increasing full year 2026 guidance for net revenue, adjusted EBITDA, and adjusted diluted EPS.
The Company is also updating operating cash flow guidance, reflecting working capital, including higher inventory levels in key growth areas.
The live webcast and presentation will be accessible through the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at https://investors.amneal.com.
Further, our historical adjusted results are not intended to project our adjusted results of operations or financial position for any future period.

For 2025, asset impairment charges primarily related to a Specialty segment product right for which the Company significantly reduced the cash flow forecast after receipt of a complete response letter dated July 22, 2025 from the U.S.
